title: Chef'n SleekStor Pinch Pour Prep Bowls
text: Chef'n SleekStor Pinch Pour Prep Bowls. The were not exactly what I was expecting...  due to the material they are made of, they are better suited for liquids than dry spices/rubs, etc.  Got the green set for myself and the red set for my daughter-in-law...  Haven't heard from her regarding how she liked them...

product_metadata.title: Chef'n SleekStor Pinch+Pour Prep Bowl Set (Green Tonal)
features: Keep organized while preparing favorite dishes with this set of multi-function nesting prep bowls.
With clearly marked measurements for wet and dry ingredients, there is no need for additional measuring cups or spoons.
Pinch the bowl frame to create a pour spout for liquids and powdered ingredients.
Nest the bowls together to store when not in use.
These bowls are dishwasher safe on the top rack and are not recommended for use in the microwave.
description: Breeze through food preparation tasks with the beautifully designed Chef'n SleekStor Pinch+Pour Prep Bowl Set (Green Tonal). Keep organized while preparing favorite dishes with this set of multi-function nesting prep bowls. With clearly marked measurements for wet and dry ingredients, there is no need for additional measuring cups or spoons. Pinch the bowl frame to create a pour spout for liquids and powdered ingredients. Nest the bowls together to store when not in use. These bowls are dishwasher safe on the top rack and are not recommended for use in the microwave.
